children: Overview
Faroe Islands salmon farmer's Q2 operational EBIT rose sharply, driven by higher harvest volumes
Company's Scotland operations remained impacted by low harvest volumes and biological challenges
Group maintains 2026 harvest guidance of 117,000 tonnes
Outlook
Bakkafrost maintains 2026 harvest guidance of 117,000 tonnes gutted weight
Company expects tighter global salmon supply in H2 2026, improving market balance
Bakkafrost raises expected 2026 feed production to around 175,000 tonnes
Result Drivers
FAROE ISLANDS PERFORMANCE - Strong biological performance, higher harvest volumes and lower farming costs in Faroe Islands drove Q2 results
SCOTLAND CHALLENGES - Low harvest volumes and biological issues in one batch of externally sourced smolt weighed on Scottish results
FEED COST INFLATION - Exceptional inflation in feed raw material costs required adjustments to sourcing and feed formulations
